newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shares of prominent Japan firms down on strong yen.
newsitem.headline: Shares of prominent Japan firms down on strong yen.

text.p: Shares of well-known Japanese companies slipped on Wednesday morning, hurt by expectations that the yen's rise against the dollar might reduce the profits of the export-oriented firms, traders said.
As of 0121 GMT, the share price of Sony Corp was down 60 yen at 9,670, Toyota Motor Corp 30 yen at 3,550 and Honda Motor Co Ltd 70 yen at 3,560.
Other decliners among blue-chips were Canon Inc, which was 150 yen lower at 2,700 at midday, TDK Corp, off 250 yen at 8,650, and Bridgestone Corp, down 110 yen at 2,640.
